_doc.what: Every spell AND every non-spell skill priced in M (one measure, ITEM_POWER.md) at L50 on the scale Kit approved 2026-10-28. Use it for magic item spell picks (pills, potions, scrolls, wands, staves), granted skills, onEquip casts and any spell or skill price question.
_doc.worn: permanent affect on a worn item; null when it has no affect meaning (nukes, heals, pets, item-making rituals)
_doc.charge: one use: one pill/potion/scroll or one wand/staff charge; charges price linearly (x10 wand = 10 x charge)
_doc.grant: item-granted skill (grantskills, learned 100), char-less base the gear sage would give
_doc.src: per price: 'kit' = Kit set it, 'rescaled' = model mapped monotonically onto Kit's scale (scripts/spell-value/gen/sv_rescale.py)
_doc.model: the raw model numbers before Kit (worn/charge/grant), for reference only
_doc.excluded: Kit's per-spell exclusion from magic items (R2 and the high-signature rule are dropped)
_doc.pvp: Kit weighs PK too: spell resistance and similar are priced for PvP, not only PvE
_doc.edit: Kit edits values in the artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/FNB18r6xaUD5editrNkFrY; sync with scripts/spell-value/spell-value.py --merge
_doc.skills: Non-spell skills (generic, clan, racial, card, craft, and affect-only basic skills such as set bonuses and tattoo gifts) are the records with charge null: a skill is no consumable. type 'skill' = a usable skill; an affect-only basic skill keeps a spell type (buff, malediction, utility) and grant null. worn = the skill's own affect kept permanently on the wearer (null: no lasting affect on its user, e.g. bash, kick, passives); grant = the skill at learned 100 from an item, the gear sage's char-less base value (ga_grantsValue, target 0) x the share of the 13 played professions that lack it at L50: skills in ga_grantDefs mirror the C++, the rest use its closest frame (attacks ga_bestMeleeNuke damage + victim lag, extra attacks GK_EXTRA, parry/dodge/blocks GK_AVOID, self-buffs GK_BUFF, pets GK_PET, utility GK_FIXED). Model numbers are mapped onto Kit's scale with the same per-family maps as the spells (sv_rescale.py), so src is 'rescaled'. excluded is true for every skill (no magic item use). Generator: scripts/spell-value/gen/skill_value.py (facts gen/skill_facts.py, frames gen/skill_model.py); estimates are flagged in note.
